comparisonPlan.marketBenchmarkReason: deterministic codec conformance is judged against frozen bytes, properties, and a frozen operation-specific independent oracle rather than a market image editor

partitions.captureSessionRule: one captureSessionId per generation session; sessions never cross partitions
partitions.categoryFloor: all three planned repetitions of every registered source in every category must pass
partitions.confidenceMethod: finite-stratum exact counts and descriptive rates only; no population inference
partitions.diagnosticRetryRule: diagnostic runs are outside formal results and cannot replace or erase a registered attempt
partitions.eligibilityRule: exactly one registered independent source with complete rights, family, session, category, and immutable asset hashes
partitions.exclusionRule: only pre-run rights withdrawal, proven cross-partition lineage contamination, or corrupt custody; retain exclusion record in denominator ledger
partitions.failureTimeoutCancelTreatment: each remains a distinct non-pass outcome in its registered-source denominator
partitions.internalRetryRule: zero retries for valid outcomes; maximum one replacement per source across all three repetitions only after a predeclared invalid no-result attempt
partitions.invalidRunRule: only runner-crash-before-result, custody-interruption, or integrity-check-failure before a result; at most one total replacement per source across all three planned repetitions; it may replace only its corresponding no-result attempt; retain all attempts
partitions.missingResultTreatment: missing remains a distinct non-pass outcome in its registered-source denominator
partitions.overallThreshold: all registered sources pass all three repetitions with zero false allow, false reject, failure, timeout, cancellation, missing, or unknown
partitions.sourceFamilyRule: one sourceFamilyId per independent construction lineage; derivatives remain in one partition
partitions.sourceLevelAggregation: all-three-planned-repetitions-must-pass; one allowed invalid rerun replaces only its no-result attempt
partitions.sourcePopulation: registered project-original synthetic raw source PNG bytes generated independently for Slice 05 open research
partitions.stoppingRule: close exactly at the frozen registered source set; no early success, denominator reduction, majority vote, or data-dependent extension
partitions.userExecutionRule: not-applicable: offline evidence run has no user execution
